digest.component_or_area: review_kernel Pass-2 telemetry propagation (plan_review and code_review pipelines)
propositions: code_review pipeline logs contract violations but does not record them to a sink, causing verification telemetry to be lost at the coverage level
plan_review and code_review both call reshape_verifications() and check has_violations, but only plan_review propagates contract violation data via a ContextVar sink and coverage dict

outcome_counts (clean/recovered/empty_outcomes/unrecoverable) from verify_findings() cannot be reconstructed at the *_decide boundary after workflow engine merges per-chunk outputs, so a whole-run tally helper must compute it from merged data instead
the ContextVar-backed contract violation sink (currently private to plan_review/orchestrator.py) must be moved to review_kernel and reused by both pipelines to eliminate duplication

code_review needs to activate the shared contract-violation sink in _run_code_review_gate, call record_contract_violation() in code_review_decide, and drain it into finalize_code_review_verdict's coverage
